action.description: Lifecycle verb against host cron entries. 'install' writes a vetted entry; 'remove' deletes by name; 'list' enumerates entries owned by the mesh; 'validate' parses an expression without persisting.

expression.description: Standard 5-field cron expression in the host's timezone. Runner rejects @reboot, *<60s equivalents, and shell metacharacters in the parsed form.

command_template.description: Vetted command template id. The mesh maintains an allowlist of templates (e.g. 'mesh-invoke', 'log-rotate', 'backup-snapshot'); arbitrary shell strings are not accepted.

command_args.description: Arguments substituted into the chosen template. Schema is template-specific and validated at install time.

next_runs.description: Computed forward firings (UTC) — useful for sanity-checking an expression before install. Up to 5.

entries.description: Populated for action='list'. Only mesh-owned entries are visible; user crontab is not enumerated.

errors.description: Parse or validation errors. Empty on success.

summary: Manage host-level cron entries through vetted command templates. Distinct from scheduled-task (which runs inside the mesh scheduler); use cron-task only when a host-side trigger is required (e.g. survives mesh restart).
notes: Prefer 'scheduled-task' for mesh-internal recurring work; reach for cron-task only when a host-anchored trigger is genuinely required. Arbitrary shell is intentionally not exposed — that path is a privilege-escalation hazard.
